description.en: Opens a built-in menu scene (e.g. the save menu, shop menu, team-organize menu) by name as a child scene layered over the current one, optionally passing extra menu-specific arguments.
Name of the menu scene to open, e.g. "SaveMenu", "ShopMenu", "PlotMenu".

Likely true once the child menu scene was created; null if the call was invalid (no menu name given). The success value is produced by an internal scene-creation helper that wasn't fully traceable from the decompiled code.

example.code:
// Open the plot/story menu as a child scene
CMND_MAKE_CHILD_MENU_SCENE("PlotMenu");
